compressed.name: study4f-m1-execution.tar.gz
compressed.gzip_n_flag_rationale: -n omits the filename and timestamp from the gzip header so the compression step is deterministic.

blob.upload_method: staged block upload, 48 blocks of 64 MiB, then Put Block List

round_trip_verification.method: The blob was downloaded back from Azure Blob and re-hashed on the execution host.

what_this_establishes: The exact container that executed all ten cells is preserved as a frozen archive with a recorded SHA-256, independently of the ephemeral NVMe it was built on.
The archive survived a full round trip through Azure Blob byte-identically, so the storage transport boundary preserves bytes.
The base image is pinned by the same digest registered in the repository Dockerfile, so a registry mirror could not have substituted a different image.
what_this_does_not_establish: Nothing scientific. A container archive is an engineering artifact and is not evidence about any checkpoint, about any interface or about J-space.
